oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Traduire la tradition littéraire nationale : la fabrique du canon classique dans le Kojiki d’Ikezawa Natsuki (2014)
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Through a reading of Ikezawa Natsuki’s retranslation of the Kojiki, this article examines the notion of Japanese literary tradition and its reception within the contemporary editorial and literary landscape. Ikezawa’s translation is part of the Ikezawa Natsuki=kojin henshu nihon bungaku zenshū (Anthology of Japanese literature selected by Ikezawa Natsuki), an editorial project aimed at renewing the classic literary canon with new translations by contemporary authors. Ikezawa’s translation strategy and his discourse on the Kojiki revive the vision of literature as a reflection of cultural identity, a vision first developed at the end of the 19th century. The article argues that, through this project, Ikezawa cements his position as an intermediary for Japan’s national literary heritage.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Sur la notion de « tradition » dans l’artisanat japonais
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: As globalisation progresses, reflecting on “tradition” in contemporary Japanese education is essential. In fields such as the arts, heritage, and industrial crafts, craftsmanship is again being valorised and recognised as essential to each field. Within that recognition, a common thread emerges; the significance of handicrafts. Tradition should be understood as more than simple imitation. Instead, it should be seen as an underlying current that influences wider production. In addition, there is a real need to cultivate not only the producer of an object, but also its user. In this paper, I will discuss various representations of tradition in crafts as well as offer alternative viewpoints regarding the future of education in craftsmanship.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Espace, temps et architecture japonaise : la naissance d’une nouvelle tradition temporelle
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The expression of time is widely believed today to be one of the unique features of traditional Japanese architecture. This article argues, however, that many of the apparently temporal features identified in traditional Japanese buildings are actually accommodations of change, rather than conscious expressions of time, and that similar characteristics can be found in buildings from other cultures. It suggests that the established interpretation of traditional Japanese architecture as being based on time rather than space is part of a long-standing impulse, both within and beyond Japan, to cast Japanese culture in contrast to the West.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Integrated mass drug administration for yaws eradication: evidence from a comparative observational study in Papua New Guinea and a systematic review with network meta-analysis
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Background Yaws is a chronic infectious disease that disproportionately affects under-reached communities. In 2023, Papua New Guinea (PNG) reported 100 165 suspected yaws cases, accounting for 45% of cases reported worldwide. The WHO targets yaws eradication by 2030, primarily through mass drug administration (MDA) of azithromycin. This study evaluates the impact of an integrated MDA programme in PNG and reviews global evidence on optimal MDA strategies through a network meta-analysis (NMA).Methods A comparative observational study was undertaken analysing outpatient department (OPD) attendances between West New Britain province (WNB; intervention) and New Ireland province (NIP; comparator) from November 2023 to August 2024. The intervention in WNB involved a single-round, integrated four-drug MDA provided in December 2023, comprising azithromycin, ivermectin, diethylcarbamazine and albendazole. Temporal trends in OPD attendances were analysed using negative binomial regression. A Bayesian NMA of six studies identified through a systematic review compared the effectiveness of azithromycin-based regimens for yaws eradication.Results Between Q3 2023 and Q1 2024, yaws-related OPD attendances in WNB declined significantly, with a 41% (p<0.0001) reduction relative to the comparator province (NIP). This reduction was sustained for at least 6 months following MDA. Over the same period, a 33% decline in total skin-related outpatient attendances was observed. In the NMA, three rounds of azithromycin MDA were associated with lower odds of active yaws at follow-up than observation (OR 0.04, 95% CrI 0.005 to 0.24) and had the highest probability of being ranked most effective. Single-round azithromycin MDA was also associated with reduced odds of active yaws at follow-up (OR 0.15, 95% CrI 0.05 to 0.45).Conclusion In a high-burden setting, a single round of integrated MDA was associated with substantial early reductions in yaws burden. Multi-round azithromycin strategies, particularly three-round regimens, were associated with larger and more sustained reductions in community prevalence. These findings inform considerations for yaws control efforts in settings with persistent transmission.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Perceptions des enseignements et stratégies d’apprentissage en première année universitaire
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Early research has explored the relationship between students’ perceptions of teaching and their approaches to learning (Diseth et al., 2006). This study builds on that work by examining both aspects of the teaching–learning process simultaneously, distinguishing between students’positive and negative evaluations of a course. The study has three objectives : to identify students’ perceptions of teaching, to analyze their learning strategies, and to explore potential differences in the types of strategies used depending on their evaluation of the course. The qualitative study, based on interviews with first-year university students (N = 44), highlights three key factors in students’ evaluations : their dispositions toward learning, the attitudes and behaviors of teachers, and the perceived quality of instruction, which may reflect either transmissive or active teaching methods. It also shows how students’ appreciation of a course influences their learning strategies : when teaching is appreciated, strategies tend to be more diverse, deeper, and combined; when teaching is not appreciated, strategies are more limited, less integrated, and mainly oriented toward performance. Finally, interactions with both teachers and peers appear to be rarely used, regardless of whether the teaching is positively or negatively evaluated.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Climat de confiance, engagement à l’université et rôle des activités brise-glaces
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This paper looks at the development of a climate of trust in university classes. Several studies have shown the importance of a climate of trust in supporting student engagement in learning. Using questionnaires and semi-structured interviews, we collected students' perceptions of the importance they attach to a climate of trust and the factors that encourage its development and maintenance. The survey was conducted in the context of a 2nd year undergraduate course based on NovaTris pedagogy, an active and experiential teaching method. For the students interviewed, the establishment of a climate of trust encourages learning and relationships in the classroom. Both the trainer and the students have a part to play in developing and maintaining it. A climate of trust and the emotional, behavioural and cognitive engagement of the students go hand in hand : one supports and encourages the other. The students also emphasise the benefits of ice-breakers in developing such a climate and their commitment to learning.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Stratégies de soutien pour améliorer les conditions de réalisation des études dans le domaine infirmier
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Psychological distress and the intention to abandon the study program are widespread among nursing students. The study conditions, such as workload and school-work-life conflicts, are contributing. This research was part of a project that included a quantitative phase carried out beforehand, which provided an overview of the study conditions among nursing students in Quebec (Cégep and university). This article presents the subsequent qualitative phase. The objective was to explore support strategies to improve study conditions by gathering the perspectives of those concerned (nursing students and employees). The theoretical models of Karasek (1979) and Siegrist (1996) framed this research. An online self-administered questionnaire collected suggestions from 114 students to improve study conditions in their respective school. Two focus group interviews were conducted in each targeted school with students (6) and staff members (10). Paillé and Mucchielli’s thematic analysis revealed one common support strategy category across schools, "promote the balance of studies, work, and personal life," and two other categories : "support the continuation of college studies" in Cégep and "facilitate the transition between the DEC and the BAC" at the university. Considering the differences between schools, this study supports the involvement of stakeholders to develop support strategies that can improve study conditions.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Formation continue en haute école : étude des rapports sociaux de sexe dans les dispositifs certifiants destinés au corps enseignant
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This article examines gender inequalities in continuing education programs for teachers at a teacher training college in French-speaking Switzerland. Despite a legislative framework promoting gender equality, the findings reveal persistent structural disparities in access to and participation in these programs. The mixed-method approach combines descriptive analysis of enrollment data from nineteen certificate programs (2022-2024), participant observation within a working group of program coordinators and scientific staff, and a reflective workshop with continuing education professionals.The analyses reveal marked horizontal segregation : pedagogical and support programs, as well as those related to primary education, are predominantly attended by women, while technical, scientific, and leadership programs show a more balanced gender distribution. Qualitative data demonstrate that the articulation between family responsibilities and program organization (schedules, formats, duration) produces differentiated access constraints according to gender.This study contributes to an under-researched field – gender relations in teacher continuing education – and proposes institutional mechanisms to strengthen accessibility and equal recognition of specialization areas.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Je parle, ils prennent des notes. Mais comment? Une typologie en cinq profils
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This study explores students' note-taking strategies in an authentic context by combining three complementary methodologies : direct observation, analysis of written productions, and metagraphic interviews. Eleven master's students were observed during a lecture, their notes were collected and analyzed inductively, and five of them were interviewed to explain their choices and strategies. The analysis identified five distinct profiles : those who favor structured handwritten note-taking, those who incorporate images, those who adopt a list format, those who enrich their notes with personal annotations serving as reminders or goals for future actions, and those who take notes collaboratively on a shared document. These findings highlight the diversity of strategies used and emphasize the need for pedagogical support that promotes note-taking adapted to students' needs and the requirements of learning contexts.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Les actions enseignantes pour favoriser l’intégration des étudiants à distance dans les cours comodaux en enseignement supérieur
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Student integration is defined as an interactive process through which students become full members of the university community, along three dimensions : academic (performance and intellectual development), social (involvement in activities and interpersonal relationships), and professional (positive experience in their career path) (Roberts, 2012). The objective of this study is to identify the actions teachers take to increase attendance and promote the integration of distance students into blended learning courses at the graduate level. Few previous studies have focused on student integration in blended learning courses. The Community of Inquiry model by Garrison et al. (2000) was used in this research to define cognitive, teaching, and social presence, to which institutional presence was added. To meet the study's objective, a qualitative methodology was adopted, and a non-probability convenience sample of volunteer participants was selected. The participants were students (n = 8) enrolled in a graduate education program offering only blended learning courses, their instructors (n = 5), and their technical support staff (n = 5). Semi-structured individual interviews and a focus group were used as data collection methods. The data were then subjected to content analysis using NVivo 14. The results show that instructors increase attendance by offering collaborative opportunities such as group work (social presence), feedback and practical activities (instructor presence), and support measures (institutional presence), thereby promoting the students' academic, social, and professional integration.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: L’enseignement supérieur pour la justice cognitive : étude de cas du réseau Ecoversities Alliance
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Despite their positive impacts on society, mainstream higher education institutions generate cognitive injustices by overvaluing some ways of being and knowing over others. To attenuate this trend, research on cognitive justice in higher education has recently emerged as a growing field of inquiry. On a theoretical level, the importance of promoting cognitive justice is well documented for both its social and environmental benefits. However, on an empirical level, academic literature is scarce, although there are numerous initiatives that aim to promote cognitive justice in higher education, including the Ecoversities Alliance which brings together more than 260 higher education alternatives called ecoversities. This article presents the results of a case study that draws on a thematic analysis of 28 written publications and 10 semi-structured interviews with members of the alliance to describe how it strives to promote cognitive justice in a perspective of environmental and social emancipation.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Contradictions institutionnelles de la professionnalisation universitaire des enseignants. Le cas d'un dispositif de formation tunisien
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This article explores the institutional contradictions and professional tensions that shape the process of academizing teacher education (Lessard and D’Arrisso, 2010). It draws on a doctoral research project focused on the implementation of reflexivity within the training of Tunisian primary school teachers. The adopted methodological and analytical approach, institutional socio-clinical (Monceau, 2018), employs three complementary tools : participant observation, document analysis, and comprehensive semi-structured interviews. This methodological triangulation helps illuminate the institutional dynamics at play within the training process. Contradictions and tensions are examined through the analysis of subjective implications expressed by both trainees and trainers. The effects of participant involvement, including that of the researcher, are also considered within a framework of critical co-analysis of the institutional dynamics in tension.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Faire face à l’« échec » étudiant.Comment les enseignants de sociologie ajustent leurs pratiques pédagogiques
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The massification of higher education in France has led to the emergence of the issue of ‘student failure’ in public discourse. Universities, which enrol the majority of students, are suspected of leading many of their undergraduate students to ‘fail’ their exams. In this article, I examine the phenomenon of ‘student failure’ in an original way, applying the usual tools of sociology to the study of its own teaching. I focus on university sociology lecturers and their perspective on ‘failure’ : how do they perceive their students' abilities and difficulties (difficulties in understanding, poor exam results) and how do they respond to them in practice?These questions are treated as a problem of the sociology of work. University lecturers are workers, whose activity can be studied sociologically. To this end, I draw on field research conducted in a sociology department at a French university, which consisted of direct, long-term observation of teaching work and interactions between lecturers and their students.The article shows how sociology teachers adjust their practices to the difficulties they perceive in their students and how these adjustments are a result of the context and the positions these teachers occupy. It presents the elements of the debate among them on adapting to students' difficulties and specifies the positions that this debate corresponds to, then the actual methods of adjusting teaching practices to sociology students and their variations : adjustments to the knowledge they teach, their teaching practices and assessments.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Entre invisibilité et visibilité
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Entre 1918 et 1924, le missionnaire et ethnologue allemand Martin Gusinde a produit une archive photographique des peuples autochtones de la Patagonie chilienne. Les images représentant les esprits de la cérémonie du Hain du peuple Selk’nam ont fait l’objet d'appropriations artistiques croissantes à partir des années 2000 au Chili, puis à des fins lucratives. Analyser ces appropriations dans le champ de l’art permet de montrer comment les régimes de visibilité du peuple Selk’nam se pluralisent, encourageant leur surgissement dans l'espace social et promouvant des relectures critiques de l’histoire du Chili. C'est dans ce contexte que le peuple Selk’nam, considéré disparu dans les années 1960, obtient sa reconnaissance comme peuple vivant du Chili en 2023. Cependant, l’appropriation commerciale et patrimoniale de ces photographies fétichise leur identité culturelle et occulte le processus de (re)construction de leur autochtonie.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Le détournement de l’image
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: L’article explore le détournement de l’image dans la poésie visuelle, un mouvement artistique international qui a émergé après la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Le détournement consiste à réutiliser des images existantes afin de leur donner de nouvelles significations. Les poètes visuels explorent une variété de techniques telles que le collage, le photomontage, la superposition, la juxtaposition, la vidéo. L’objectif principal est d’interroger le statut de l’image, de remettre en question ses conventions et de créer des messages poétiques innovants. L’article présente des exemples de poètes visuels italiens et de leurs œuvres, mettant en avant l’importance de l’Italie dans ce mouvement. Il rappelle également l’influence du futurisme et aborde ce phénomène artistique depuis l’après-guerre jusqu’à aujourd’hui.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Le visage réinterprété
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Cette étude examine les procédés de représentation du visage princier dans l’Espagne moderne, à partir des portraits El príncipe don Carlos (1557) et La infanta Catalina Micaela (1585), réalisés par Antonio Sánchez Coello et Juan Pantoja de la Cruz. Entre exigences de ressemblance et idéalisation iconographique, elle interroge la construction visuelle de la Majesté à travers des visages réinterprétés, en lien avec les théories physiognomoniques et les traités d’art en vigueur à l’époque. L’attention portée aux stratégies d’embellissement et d’omission, mises en œuvre de manière différenciée selon le sujet représenté, éclaire la fonction politique assignée à l’image royale. L’analyse met également en évidence la réappropriation du prognathisme de Charles Quint comme signe de gravitas et de légitimité dynastique.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: La manipolazione dell’immagine durante il Ventennio
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Dès les premières années qui suivent la naissance de la photographie, on assiste au phénomène de la manipulation et de la retouche d’images qui étaient considérées comme plus objectives que l’illustration. Le fascisme a su profiter à la fois de l’importance que prenait la photographie et de la naïveté du public, qui n’était pas en mesure de comprendre les manipulations et les trucages. Les photographies utilisées par la propagande n’étaient pas toujours des montages ou des faux, mais même certaines de celles qui semblaient être des instantanés étaient en fait aidées par la pose, les lumières, le cadrage. La sélection qui permettait d’éliminer les photographies non réussies ou qui ne convenaient pas au régime et de sélectionner les plus démonstratives était également importante. Ainsi, des images affligeantes ont été utilisées pour montrer la triste « réalité » concernant les peuples ennemis ou « non civilisés » ; par contre on ne montrait que le meilleur côté de l’Italie et de son dirigeant, Mussolini. Cela amène finalement à se demander si les dérives actuelles liées au monde numérique n’ont pas commencé avec la naissance de la photographie, qui nous ment dès ses débuts, même si elle se présente comme une vision impartiale de l’instant qu’elle capture.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Les icônes de la violence
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Cette étude propose une analyse du processus de construction d’un imaginaire commun sur les années 1970 en Italie à partir d’un ensemble hétérogène d’archives visuelles. Les mêmes signes iconiques sont véhiculés sur les supports les plus variés et, migrant d’un média à l’autre, trouvent aujourd’hui dans l’internet un mode de circulation dématérialisé. Une lecture à l’aune des outils issus d’approches variées (Visual Studies) met au jour les mécanismes qui président à la circulation et à la réécriture des images qui sont examinées sous l’angle de leurs usages dans le temps. L’article met en évidence d’abord les éléments qui déterminent une imagerie dominée par la violence, dont les photographies d’Aldo Moro sont un exemple, pour évoquer ensuite quelques réemplois qui témoignent de la manière dont la matrice visuelle initiale subit progressivement des exploitations conjoncturelles. L’iconographie de ces années, considérée dans une optique socio-historique, conduit à prendre en compte également les enjeux mémoriels de cette période caractérisée par une forte conflictualité sociale.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Postfascistes ?
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: L’article examine la propagande visuelle de l’extrême droite parlementaire italienne depuis 1995, lorsque le Movimento Sociale Italiano, ouvertement néo-fasciste, a été dissous par son dirigeant Gianfranco Fini et remplacé par Alleanza Nazionale, un parti qui se décrit comme « post-fasciste ». L’analyse iconographique montre que, malgré les affirmations répétées de rupture du cordon ombilical avec le régime de Mussolini, la propagande d’Alleanza Nazionale et celle de Fratelli d’Italia, le parti de Giorgia Meloni qui l’a remplacé, contiennent de fréquentes références au fascisme, voir au nazisme. Les images intègrent deux niveaux de signification : l’un manifeste et modéré, destiné au grand public, et l’autre caché, destiné aux militants, célébrant les idéaux, les valeurs et la culture du régime. L’analyse des textes accompagnant les images révèle qu’ils reprennent souvent des slogans et des devises fascistes.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Lo Stregozzo
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Gravé par Marcantonio Raimondi ou Agostino Veneziano vers 1520-1530, Lo Stregozzo est le résultat d’un assemblage d’éléments iconographiques arrachés à leur contexte d’origine et revisités. Il met en scène le défilé triomphal d’une furie, mi-sorcière mi-Invidia, représentée en train d’assujettir un Priape impuissant, qui tente de se protéger contre le mauvais œil en brandissant un fascinus « hors d’usage ». Notre contribution se propose de mettre au jour le sujet réel de la gravure, qui n’est pas tant la marche d’une sorcière et de ses acolytes vers le sabbat qu’une réflexion en images sur la pratique artistique de l’imitation. Si le Priape humilié, parodie du Démiurge michelangelesque de la Sixtine, incarne le rejet de l’imitation néoplatonicienne de l’Idée ; si la chimère représentée, parodie de celle de Zeuxis, renvoie aux limites d’une imitation purement éclectique de la nature, la gravure dans son ensemble entreprend de tracer une « troisième voie » : celle de l’imitation créatrice de l’art, à la fois syncrétique et dialectique, voire parodique.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Méduse recomposée
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Cette étude examine une toile de l’artiste italien Giulio Aristide Sartorio, La Gorgone e gli eroi. L’œuvre, achevée en 1899 après une longue gestation, est dominée par la figure de Méduse, femme belle et fatale qui, selon le mythe grec, pétrifie à travers le regard des serpents accrochés à son épaisse chevelure. Cette analyse portera notamment sur l’iconographie de la Gorgone en tant que manifestation de la conception esthétique élaborée par Sartorio au cours des années 1890. En effet, en reconstruisant les choix iconographiques adoptés par l’artiste et en étudiant en même temps ses écrits contemporains de critique d’art, ainsi que d’autres peintures parallèles à valeur programmatique, il est possible de saisir une conception esthétique de sensibilité conservatrice. Conformée selon des filiations picturales récentes et passées, nationales et internationales, la figure de la Gorgone se révèle donc une concrétion composite de fragments formels réunis en vertu d’une conception récupératrice de l’art ; un art destiné à renaître dans la lignée d’une tradition prestigieuse.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: L’image intermédiale dans la dystopie filmique Corazón azul
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Dans Corazón azul (2021), film dystopique de Miguel Coyula, la critique radicale du totalitarisme cubain et de la dégénérescence du projet révolutionnaire passe par une expérimentation formelle qui mêle science-fiction, montage ciselé et intermédialité foisonnante. Situé dans un futur cauchemardesque où le régime a conçu des humains génétiquement modifiés et dangereux pour le corps social, le film figure la perte de sens et la fragmentation identitaire à travers une esthétique de la manipulation généralisée : celle de la génétique et autres expérimentations échouées de la Révolution, mais aussi celle des images, des médias, et même des propres codes cinématographiques, dans une réflexion métafilmique assez vertigineuse. Cette étude explore les différents phénomènes intermédiaux tels que la vraie ou fausse citation audiovisuelle multiforme (publicité, informations de presse, télévisuelles ou internet, archives…), la reconfiguration du réel par l’image ou la mise en abyme filmique, et leurs usages comme questionnement de l’histoire, de la mémoire, des médias globalisés, des frontières de l’humain, mais aussi comme forte revendication libertaire.

À partir de l’analyse de la structuration conceptuelle et figurative de ce tableau, nous nous interrogeons ici sur la possibilité même, pour l’exégèse discursive, de forcer la résistance naturelle des images aux mots.

oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Dans cet article nous nous penchons sur un genre qui a connu un grand succès dans l’Espagne des xvie et xviie siècles : le livre d’emblèmes. oai_dc:dc.dc:description: À travers l’analyse croisée des ekphraseis et des photographies, nous aborderons l’activité de traduction à laquelle se livre Javier Marías et dégagerons le regard qu’il porte sur Valle Inclán puis sur lui-même dans Miramientos. L’autoportrait, par le ludique dédoublement qu’il installe, nous permettra d’envisager les rapports de l’écrivain à sa propre image. Nous montrerons que si Javier Marías semble à première vue élaborer une autoreprésentation conforme à son ethos, il tente aussi de l’infléchir pour offrir une version améliorée de lui-même.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Voir ce qu’il ne faut pas entendre
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: La chanson Le Blason repose sur le principe d’une paralipse. En prétendant faire l’éloge du sexe féminin, c’est en fait un mot tabou que Georges Brassens décrit sans le nommer. L’emploi du mot « con », dont l’homonymie affecte le canteur, y est malicieusement détourné : son image acoustique et graphémique apparaît en filigrane tout au long de la chanson. Ces images rémanentes du signifiant, plus ou moins subliminales, convoquent le signifié, pudiquement voilé par les préoccupations métalinguistiques. Dès lors, la traduction de la chanson devra jouer sur la transposition de ces images. Rimes, métaphores, jeux sur l’hypotexte et le paratexte : les trois traducteurs (Piero d’Ostra, Beppe Chierici, Salvo Lo Galbo) utilisent des procédés différents pour faire apparaître le signifiant aux yeux et aux oreilles du public italophone. Le jeu sur la tabouïsation révèle les questions sur l’esthétique du discours chanté, et met en évidence la dimension synesthésique de l’écoute.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Faire avec le risque : religiosité et rationalités pratiques entre Java, Kuala Lumpur et Singapour
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: In response to the major risks associated with migration, Indonesian migrant workers in Malaysia and Singapore develop ritual, magical, and religious (i.e., spiritual) practices to ward off misfortune. oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This article examines how risks are perceived and framed in the case of female domestic workers’ migration. oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Exacerbating already existing political and social tensions, the pandemic has revealed the structural weaknesses of some states in dealing with migratory flows and the issue of receiving exiles and displaced persons. The health and policy responses adopted by these states have had specific impacts in a region where the frequency and density of mobility are high, and where conflicts have constantly made populations more precarious and weakened the state actors capable of responding to crises. We describe how the various political forces involved seized on the health crisis to consolidate their power, redefine their migration policy(ies) and reorient the management of displaced persons. It is also a question of questioning the production of scientific knowledge in the human and social sciences in a context of health crisis in which researchers are themselves confronted with the closure of borders and forced to remain inactive.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Le « printemps arabe » : une révolution pour l’émigration égyptienne ?
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This article examines the impacts of Arab revolutions on Egyptian emigration, according to the diverse temporalities which have rythmed the political life of the country and the region between 2011 and 2015. Emigration doesn’t mean an exit which makes disappear all sense of loyalty: the moral obligation to participate to the development of their country has fuelled the return of many migrants in the early days of the revolution. oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The “Silk Road” is one of the most popular terms used by political stakeholders (and in a few cases by academics) to describe the insertion of the Central Asian states into globalisation. In comparison with the circulation of goods and persons at the global scale, transit flows through Central Asia are marginal, due to the domination of maritime transport. oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Changements et permanences dans la protection des réfugiés
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Change and Continuity in the Protection of Refugees. The regime of protection for refugees put into place by the Geneva Convention of 1951 has given way to a new regime on asylum originating in Brussels. The first, centred around on the right to leave one’s country, used the defence of human rights and the reception of dissidents to discredit the communist world. The second is more complex. Refugee status granted by the Geneva Convention is recognised in small doses; the subsidiary protection allows the supervision of the asylum seekers that can be dismissed but not expulsed ; asylum near conflict zones helps to limit flows and to justify the right of Western powers to interfere. The evolution between the two regimes reveals that it is international relations and migration policy, and not human rights that condition the organisation of asylum.

oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The launching of the diplomatic relations between GDR and Egypt on 10 July 1969 brought to completion an economic and cultural rapprochement process initiated as early as the mid-50s. From then on, a cohort of Egyptians nationals – students and workers alike – would travel to GDR every year to be dispensed a “popular training” that was soon to become one of the major components of the bilateral cooperation between the two countries. These – tightly supervised – mobility flows gave birth to an intense networking between scientists, intellectuals and left wing activists, with strikingly dissimilar expectations on each side. The acquaintance process sparked by this cultural and linguistic immersion nevertheless contributed in no small degree to the bringing closer of both countries’ political and artistic elites. The relations thus achieved were complex and not always guided by pure ideology. And their social repercussions fluctuated from adaptation to confrontation. By analyzing the mechanisms of this cultural and techno-scientific bilateral cooperation, the present paper proposes to show the limits of East Berlin’s attempted “socialist remodeling” of its Egyptian partner.

oai_dc:dc.dc:description: In Melilla, Spanish enclave in the Mediterranean, on the African continent, migrants tell numerous stories about death during border crossing. The author examine here the form and the content of these narratives, collected during an ethnographic field study carried out between 2014 and 2016, by exploring what they say about contemporary migration.

oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Drawing on an interview-based study, this article explores the ambivalent nature and contours of privilege linked to origin, race and class of judges/prosecutors in the French overseas territories. oai_dc:dc.dc:description: On Transnational Migration : Vietnamese Canadian Examples. This article aims at answering two intimately linked questions : up to what point may Vietnamese Canadians — and, most probably, overseas Vietnamese living elsewhere in the world — be considered transmigrants, and what are the principal characteristics of their transnational activities ? The definition of transnational migration used here is chiefly inspired by Portes and Glick Schiller. It implies that transmigrants participate in a steady way in the economy, politics and social relations of their homeland, while, at the same time, being relatively well inserted in the structures of their adopted country. An examination of the transnational economic, political and family-related activities of Vietnamese Canadians brings us to the conclusion that most of them can be considered as “passive transmigrants.” They are not involved in business activities in Vietnam, and they do not play any active role in the leadership of local or international ethnic organisations, nor do they utter anti-Communist or pro-Vietnam political discourses. However, most of them feel interested in, and concerned by Vietnam as a Nation-State and, in a more fundamental way, they belong to trans-border kinship networks which enable many of them to be regularly involved in transnational relations, whether individually or as members of a household. This importance of kinship networks, considered by their participants as more significant than formal economic and political structures, most probably constitutes the principal characteristic of overseas Vietnamese.

oai_dc:dc.dc:description: International Mobility in Central Europe: Tourists, Traders and Migrants. -- Central Europe has been typical for a high volume of international travel, which further increased during transition period. This paper analyses particular kinds of cross-border mobility (labour migration, petty trading and tourism) and exemplifies these via a number of authors' surveys. The surveys found great differences in cross-border mobility patterns generated in different socio-economic systems. The Central Europe migrants heading for the European Union labour markets, for example, had significantly lower deskilling levels and accounted for different saving patterns than the Community of Independent Migrants in Central Europe. As for the cross-border petty trading by the CIS nationals in Central Europe, the traders had similar social backgrounds, motives and saving patterns as the labour migrants. The latter one is generated via price differences, originates in poorer regions and is related to survival strategies of young families.

This article details the conditions of starting a union by sub-Saharan immigrants after their arrival in France. We use data from the ANRS-Parcours biographical survey conducted in 2012-2013 in Paris area. Men enter less quickly into union than their female counterparts. For women, however, couples do not appear to be dependent on their administrative or professional situation. It would even seem that the fact of entering a union would enable them to improve their living conditions.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Editorial: New Ethnic Issues
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The issue of ethnicity has always been a controversial one, especially in France — whether on the mainland in relation to regional minorities or migrants, or in the French overseas territories. As a former colonial Empire and an epitome of secular republicanism, France resists use of any ethnic identification, including in the academic world and anthropology. This topical collection reconsiders this position and takes stock of the “ethnic situations” in relation to the new postcolonial and post-socialist historical conditions, the generalisation of the global market, the accelerated movement of goods and people, as well as the intensification of the diasporic phenomenon. The various contributions provide insights into specific ethnic affiliations, seen from the inside, in diverse ethnographic fields related to migration to France, from Senegal, Morocco, Comoros, Asia, or within the framework of particular French institutions.This editorial seeks to give space to consideration of the issue of ethnicity, emancipating it from its current national suppression in France, by connecting it to other currents of thought developed by non-French, French-speaking sociologists, such as Danielle Juteau, and English-speaking sociologists, in particular Jean and John Comaroff, who have addressed this topical collection in diverse national contexts (Quebec, United States, South Africa, China, etc.). The authors of this editorial and coordinator of this topical collection emphasise that ethnic affiliations show a real capacity of adaptation, paradoxically using it as a means of integration into the French urban economy and republican landscape, as a way to promote their form of citizenship. They show how this sociological category can be interpreted by individuals in a rigid way, or with openness to other ethnic markers, thus demonstrating “transethnic competence”. They conclude that, far from being an archaism, ethnic dynamics are always at work in contexts dominated by national representations. Moreover, ethnic identification, one of the modalities of perception of otherness, which should not be limited to minorities as it also concerns majority groups, deserves a specific approach, distinct from race and discrimination. oai_dc:dc.dc:title: My HP Deskjet 3755
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The video creation My HP Deskjet 3755 is part of an investigation on printers, a technological device that has become particularly problematic in the wake of climate emergency through the opacity of its functioning and its obsolescence. The way this type of printing technology is indeed envisioned makes it very difficult for users to access the design logic governing both hardware and software. Moreover, the production of these machines is largely based on a non-virtuous economic model that only works if the printer’s owners buy consumables on a regular basis. Hence, it is not unusual that some machines conceal programs in their functioning that artificially limit the amount of available ink for printing to encourage clients to buy new cartridges. To better understand how we may reconfigure the paradoxical relationship we sometimes establish with this technology, we developed a sensorial and emotional approach through touching and listening. In so doing, we sought to deviate the printer from its purpose and used it as a sound-producing instrument, from which we may sing a form of manifesto based on technological emancipation. This song-manifesto was performed by three female vocalists and one percussionist from the band Aàgut. The four verses song retraces the trajectory of our thought through the sensorial exploration of the printers’ materiality. This process allowed us to theoretically envision a world in which the relationship between machines and humans is based on values of conviviality and mutualism.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Prompt to Play: A cartomancy for outwitting AI and forming imaginaries
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Much of the dominant discourse treats artificial intelligence (AI) as detached from its material conditions. In interface design, a rhetoric of magic further diverts attention from the socio-ecological mechanisms that make AI possible. To counter this disembodied relationship to AI, and alongside descriptive and instructional approaches, artistic practices can help make visible and imaginable the links between AI’s promises, its uses, and its costs. Prompt to Play is a card-based device designed to make connections between different approaches to AI. Drawing on cartomancy, the cards guide a conversation that moves from the personal to the collective, from the local to the global, and from past trajectories to future possibilities. This article introduces the “game” by examining the discourses and narratives through which AI is encountered and understood. It also questions the tendency to treat AI as magical and suggests responding to this on the level of imaginaries.

oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Le discours dominant peine à connecter les intelligences artificielles (IA) à leurs conditions matérielles d’existence et, dans les interfaces, une rhétorique de la magie détourne l’attention des mécanismes socio-écologiques qui se jouent dans les coulisses du spectacle. Prompt to Play est un jeu de cartes dont l’objectif est de tisser des liens entre différentes approches des IA. Sur le principe de la cartomancie, les cartes guident une conversation qui navigue de l’intime au collectif, du local au global, du passé au futur. Cet article présente le « jeu » en interrogeant les discours et les récits qui entourent les expériences et les connaissances que nous avons des IA. Il interroge également leur perception magique et suggère de s’en défendre sur le terrain des imaginaires.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Mon HP Deskjet 3755
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: La création vidéo Mon HP Deskjet 3755 s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une enquête autour de l’imprimante, objet technologique rendu particulièrement problématique, dans le contexte d’urgence climatique, par l’opacité de son fonctionnement et son obsolescence. Ce genre de technologie d’impression est en effet pensé de telle manière qu’il est très difficile pour les utilisateurices d’accéder aux logiques de conception qui permettent au hardware comme au software de fonctionner. Par ailleurs, la production de ces machines repose très largement sur un modèle économique peu vertueux et qui fonctionne uniquement si les propriétaires d’imprimante achètent à intervalle régulier des consommables. De ce fait, il n’est pas rare que certaines machines dissimulent dans leur fonctionnement des programmes qui limitent artificiellement la quantité d’encre disponible à l’impression pour encourager les clients et clientes à acheter de nouvelles cartouches d’encre. Pour tenter de mieux comprendre l’imprimante et la manière dont nous pourrions reconfigurer la relation parfois paradoxale que nous tissons avec cette technologie, nous avons développé une approche sensible et affective par le toucher et l’écoute. Nous avons ainsi tenté de détourner l’usage de l’imprimante pour l’utiliser comme un instrument producteur de son, à partir duquel nous pourrions chanter une forme de manifeste autour de l’émancipation technologique. Ce chant-manifeste a été interprété par les chanteuses et le percussionniste du groupe Aàgut. Les quatre couplets qui composent ce chant retracent le cheminement de notre pensée à partir de l’exploration sensible de la matérialité des imprimantes. Cette opération nous a permis d’envisager, sous une forme spéculative, un monde dans lequel la relation entre les machines et les êtres humains serait basée sur des valeurs de convivialité et de mutualisme.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Apennines in Transitions: Between Tourism Monoculture, Depopulation and Emerging Community-Based Practices
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This paper examines, through the lens of degrowth, the tensions currently reshaping tourism in the Apennines, a mountain system marked by uneven and polarised trajectories. On the one hand, tourist flows are increasingly concentrated in a limited number of highly infrastructure-intensive hubs, predominantly oriented toward winter sports and developed according to market-driven logics. On the other hand, vast out-of-the-loop areas remain largely invisible within tourism circuits, experiencing long-term decline driven by demographic shrinkage, population ageing, and the erosion of local functions. Tourist colonisation and abandonment are thus interpreted as two interrelated outcomes of the same growth-oriented paradigm, whose structural limits are further exacerbated by climate change and persistent socio-demographic fragilities. Alongside these dominant trajectories, a ‘third way’ is emerging in specific contexts, grounded in slow, relational and community-based tourism practices. These initiatives can be read as territorially embedded experiments that challenge the structural lock-in of growth-dependent tourism models.The paper pursues three main objectives: (a) to map the morphological, socio-demographic, and functional discontinuities shaping the Apennine ridge; (b) to analyse the (un)sustainable trajectories of Apennine tourism, highlighting the coexistence of high-intensity extractive models and emerging place- and community-based practices; and (c) to examine, through a case study in the Monti Picentini, the transformative potential of these practices.The findings highlight the uneven emergence of territorial micro-innovations even in the most fragile contexts of the southern Apennines, while showing that such slow and uncertain processes can contribute to regeneration only when community-led initiatives are supported by sustained institutional commitment, thereby preventing forms of involuntary or recessionary degrowth.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Appennini in transizione tra monocultura turistica, abbandono e pratiche di comunità
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Questo contributo analizza, attraverso la lente interpretativa della decrescita, le tensioni che attraversano oggi il turismo appenninico, segnato da dinamiche divergenti: da un lato, la concentrazione dei flussi in pochi poli, prevalentemente a vocazione sciistica, pesantemente infrastrutturati secondo logiche market-driven; dall’altro, l’invisibilità e il declino di vaste aree out of the loop, escluse dai circuiti turistici e colpite da processi di spopolamento, invecchiamento e perdita di funzioni. Colonizzazione turistica e abbandono vengono così interpretati come due esiti di uno stesso paradigma turistico orientato alla crescita, i cui limiti risultano oggi amplificati dal cambiamento climatico e dalla fragilità sociodemografica.Accanto a queste due traiettorie, si va delineando, in alcuni ambiti, una “terza via”, fondata su pratiche emergenti di turismo lento, relazionale e comunitario, che possono essere lette come sperimentazioni territorialmente situate di messa in discussione della growth trap.Il lavoro persegue tre principali obiettivi: a) mappare le profonde discontinuità morfologiche, sociodemografiche e funzionali che attraversano la dorsale appenninica; b) analizzare le traiettorie (in)sostenibili del turismo appenninico, evidenziando la coesistenza tra modelli estrattivi ad alta intensità e pratiche emergenti place- e community-based; c) discutere, attraverso un caso di studio nei Monti Picentini, il potenziale trasformativo di tali pratiche.I risultati mostrano l’emergere di micro-innovazioni territoriali anche nei contesti più fragili dell’Appennino meridionale, ma evidenziano anche come tali processi, lenti e incerti, possano contribuire a percorsi di rigenerazione solo in presenza di un rafforzamento reciproco tra iniziativa comunitaria e sostegno istituzionale, evitando derive di involuntary o recessionary degrowth.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Decarbonisation and Degrowth in Mountain Tourism: Representations and Barriers to Action in the Ariège Pyrenees
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This article examines tourism stakeholders’ representations of, and barriers to, decarbonisation and degrowth in the Pyrénées Ariégeoises (France), based on 17 semi-structured interviews conducted between October 2024 and April 2025. While decarbonisation is broadly supported, it remains weakly operationalised, with few public or private actors referring to quantified targets or local carbon assessments. Individual transport is consistently identified as the main source of emissions. Key barriers to decarbonisation include limited financial and human resources, institutional complexity, and insufficient coordination between public and private actors. When explicitly questioned about degrowth as a more radical pathway, stakeholders express strong reluctance, as the concept is associated with involuntary economic decline, job losses, and the depopulation of mountain valleys. As a result, actors tend to favour notions such as “transition” or “alternative development models”. Moreover, the absence of a politically shared and credible alternative project further constrains territorial transformation. Drawing on these empirical findings and the existing literature, the article suggests moving beyond the term “degrowth” towards “post-growth”, and emphasises the need to co-construct territorially embedded and multi-level governance frameworks to support decarbonisation and a socially acceptable sustainability transition in mountain tourism destinations.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Tourisme et décroissance : une revue de littérature pour établir des pistes de recherche pour les territoires de montagne
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: La décroissance dans le secteur touristique est un champ d’étude récent. Et pour le moment, peu de recherches se sont focalisées sur la décroissance du tourisme dans les territoires de montagne. Cet article conduit une revue de littérature systématique sur cette thématique en considérant à la fois les publications avec une approche conceptuelle et les études empiriques réalisées sur différents types de destinations (urbaines, littorales, insulaires, rurales…) afin de tracer des pistes de recherche pour les territoires de montagne. Les résultats montrent que le nombre de publications a véritablement augmenté à partir de 2019. Ces publications font appel à différentes disciplines des sciences humaines et sociales, ce qui s’explique par le caractère pluridisciplinaire de l’objet « tourisme ». Après avoir détaillé les approches conceptuelles, l’analyse a porté sur les études empiriques. Il apparait que la destination « Montagne » est étudiée dans 17% des publications qui traitent majoritairement des destinations européennes. L’échelle d’analyse est majoritairement locale et les méthodes mobilisées essentiellement qualitatives. Le Structural Topic Model a été utilisé pour mettre en évidence 5 thématiques (sur-tourisme et mouvements sociaux, gestion et planification de la décroissance, tourisme communautaire, rôle des entrepreneurs et dépendance aux ressources). Les résultats des études qui se référaient à chacun de ces thèmes ont été détaillés. Par la suite, l’application des résultats de ces études de cas aux territoires de montagne a permis d’envisager des pistes de recherche, autour de la notion de la dépendance au sentier, de la mise en place de politiques de décarbonation des transports, de l’efficacité des mesures de gestion de la fréquentation et des effets rebonds ou encore d’une analyse comparative des mouvements de contestation autour des aménagements touristiques.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Tourism and Degrowth: A Literature Review to Establish a Research Agenda for Mountain Regions
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Degrowth in the tourism sector is a recent field of study. And for the moment, little research has focused on degrowth in tourism in mountain areas. This article conducts a systematic literature review on this topic, considering both publications with a conceptual approach and empirical studies carried out on different types of destinations (urban, coastal, island, rural, etc.) in order to identify avenues for research in mountain areas. The results show that the number of publications has increased significantly since 2019. These publications draw on various disciplines in the humanities and social sciences, which can be explained by the multidisciplinary nature of the subject of tourism. After detailing the conceptual approaches, the analysis focused on empirical studies. It appears that mountain destinations are studied in 17% of publications, which mainly deal with European destinations. The scale of analysis is mainly local and the methods used are essentially qualitative. The Structural Topic Model was used to highlight five themes (overtourism and social movements, degrowth management and planning, community tourism, the role of entrepreneurs and resource dependency). The results of the studies referring to each of these themes were detailed. Subsequently, the application of the results of these case studies to mountain areas made it possible to establish a research agenda, focusing on the notion of trail dependency, the implementation of transport decarbonisation policies, the effectiveness of visitor management measures and rebound effects, and a comparative analysis of protest movements around tourism developments.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Décarbonation et décroissance dans le tourisme pyrénéen : représentations et freins à l’action dans les Pyrénées Ariégeoises
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Cet article examine les représentations et les freins à la décarbonation et à l’idée de décroissance chez les acteurs et actrices touristiques des Pyrénées Ariégeoises (France), à partir de 17 entretiens semi-directifs menés entre octobre 2024 et avril 2025. La décarbonation fait consensus, mais reste peu opérationnelle et peu d’acteurs, qu’ils soient publics ou privés, mentionnent des objectifs chiffrés ou des bilans carbone locaux. Le transport individuel est identifié comme le principal poste d’émissions. Les principaux freins à la décarbonation évoqués sont le manque de moyens humains et financiers, la complexité institutionnelle et un déficit de coordination entre acteurs publics et privés. Questionnés spécifiquement sur la notion de « décroissance » comme potentielle solution radicale, celle-ci suscite une forte réticence, car associée à une réduction subie de l’activité, à la perte d’emplois et à la désertification des vallées. Les acteurs et actrices lui préfèrent les termes de « transition » ou de « modèle alternatif ». De plus, le manque de projet alternatif politiquement partagé freine la transformation du territoire. Les résultats, couplés à la littérature scientifique, suggèrent de passer du terme de « décroissance » à celui de « post-croissance », de développer un projet de territoire partagé entre l’ensemble des échelons territoriaux pour engager les territoires vers la décarbonation et une transition soutenable.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: La décroissance, une forme de transition des stations de montagne et de leurs territoires ? L’exemple de la station de Saint-Pierre-de-Chartreuse/Le Planolet
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Après une phase de forte croissance dans les années 1960 et 1970, les stations de sports d’hiver connaissent aujourd’hui des situations contrastées : alors que certaines affichent des chiffres de fréquentation records, d’autres font face à de grandes difficultés, économiques et d’enneigement, dans un contexte de changement climatique. Certaines stations amorcent alors des processus de transition, qui restent à mieux caractériser. Dans le même temps, se développe chez certains acteurs publics, académiques ou issus de la société civile, la perspective d’une décroissance, tant de l’économie en général que du secteur touristique, plus précisément. Pourtant, la manière dont la notion de la décroissance peut s’appliquer concrètement à l’échelle des territoires mérite d’être davantage explorée. Cette notion de décroissance permet-elle de mieux caractériser les trajectoires de transition des stations de montagne ? Cet article étudie la trajectoire de la station de Saint-Pierre-de-Chartreuse/Le Planolet et de son territoire au prisme de la décroissance. Il montre l’importance de mobiliser une grille de lecture incluant différentes dimensions, échelles et thématiques (le domaine skiable, le tourisme, le territoire). In fine, la décroissance semble bien constituer une grille de lecture pertinente pour éclairer les dynamiques à l’œuvre. Cependant, cet article montre aussi que la décroissance de l’activité ski ne va pas nécessairement de pair avec une décroissance du tourisme et/ou de l’économie du territoire dans son ensemble, avec des processus en cours fragiles et non-linéaires.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Is the Downsizing of Ski Areas in the French Alps Part of a Degrowth Strategy?
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Alpine skiing has been a growth driver for many mountain regions that specialise in winter tourism and remains a pillar of their economic vitality. These regions however face climatic, economic and social limits that challenge the viability of a tourism model that is struggling to reinvent itself. In response, adaptive strategies are emerging to improve the areas’ liveability, maintain the operation of ski resorts or plan a gradual phase-out of skiing. Among these approaches, the downsizing of skiing facilities, which involves removing part of a ski lift network, is a trend that has intensified in the French mountains. This intermediate trajectory, situated between the technical upgrading of production facilities and complete closure, has yet to be thoroughly analysed in terms of its role in a sustainability framework. This article examines this (de-)developmental trajectory through a degrowth lens. The central question is to determine whether the restructuring processes are simply an expression of economic decline or whether they form part of a real logic of degrowth. We first document the trajectory of downsizing identified across 18 French ski areas, then analyse the motivations underlying it, and whether they are associated with degrowth. We show that while certain processes may echo degrowth principles, in many cases the downsizing remains an expression of a decline that has been imposed. However, the reduction in facilities at Métabief in the Jura Mountains in the winter of 2024/25 illustrates that behind an apparent decline in skiing activity opportunities may emerge to organise a transitional tourism strategy, opening the way to sustainable local degrowth.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Degrowth as a Form of Transition for Mountain Resorts and their Territoires: The Case of the Saint-Pierre-De-Chartreuse/Le Planolet Ski Resort
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Following a period of strong growth in the 1960s and 1970s, winter sports resorts now find themselves in diverging situations: while some are recording all-time highs in visitor numbers, others face major economic and snow cover challenges against the backdrop of climate change. Some resorts are therefore embarking on transition processes that have as yet been little studied. In parallel, certain public, academic and civil society actors are increasingly interested in the perspective of degrowth, for both the economy as a whole and the tourism sector more specifically. However, the practical implementation of the concept of degrowth at the level of the territoires remains underexplored. Does the concept of degrowth provide us with a way to better define the transition trajectories of mountain resorts?This article examines the trajectory of the Saint-Pierre-de-Chartreuse/Le Planolet ski resort and its territoire through the lens of degrowth. It highlights the importance of mobilising an analytical framework that incorporates multiple dimensions, levels and thematic elements (the ski area, tourism and the territoire). While degrowth ultimately appears to constitute a relevant interpretative framework for exploring the dynamics involved, we also show that degrowth in skiing does not necessarily mean degrowth in tourism and/or the local economy more broadly, and highlight the presence of fragile, non-linear ongoing processes.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Le mouvement de réduction de l’offre de ski des domaines alpins français s’inscrit-il dans une stratégie de décroissance ?
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Le ski alpin a constitué un levier de croissance pour de nombreuses régions de montagne spécialisées dans le tourisme hivernal et demeure encore aujourd’hui un pilier de leur dynamisme économique. Ces territoires sont toutefois confrontés à des limites climatiques, économiques et sociales qui remettent en cause la viabilité d’un modèle touristique peinant à se réinventer. En réponse, des stratégies adaptatives émergent pour améliorer l’habitabilité des territoires, maintenir l’exploitation des domaines skiables ou préparer une sortie progressive du ski. Parmi ces orientations, la réduction de l’offre de ski, qui consiste à supprimer une partie d’un parc de remontées mécaniques, s’est récemment intensifiée dans les montagnes françaises. Cette trajectoire intermédiaire, située entre le renforcement technique de l’outil de production et la fermeture complète, reste encore peu analysée quant à sa place dans une perspective de soutenabilité. Cet article analyse cette trajectoire (dés-)aménagiste à travers le prisme du concept de décroissance. La question centrale est de déterminer si ces restructurations relèvent de la simple expression d’un déclin économique ou si elles s’inscrivent dans une véritable logique de décroissance. Nous documentons tout d’abord la trajectoire de réduction de l’offre de ski identifiée sur 18 domaines skiables français, puis analysons les motivations qui la sous-tendent, qu’elles soient ou non associées à la décroissance. Nous montrons que si certains processus peuvent faire écho à des principes de la décroissance, la réduction reste dans de nombreux cas l’expression d’un déclin subi. Toutefois, la réduction de l’équipement de Métabief, dans le massif du Jura, survenue à l’hiver 2024-2025, illustre que, derrière un déclin manifeste de l’activité ski peuvent germer des opportunités pour organiser une stratégie touristique de transition, ouvrant la voie à une décroissance territoriale soutenable.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Lessons from the Past: A Swiss Case Study on Ski Resorts and Degrowth in the Face of Climate Change
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Ski tourism is severely threatened by climate change, primarily due to reduced snowfall, shorter ski seasons, and an anticipated shrinkage of the market. These changes are increasingly dividing ski resorts into so-called “winners” and “losers”. Artificial snowmaking, although still widely used as the main adaptation strategy to climate-related impacts, faces growing challenges due to resource limitations and rising costs. Additionally, diversification, which is often promoted as the most sustainable solution, appears insufficient to compensate for the substantial losses resulting from disappearing ski seasons. In this context, fostering resilient and sustainable development in climate-impacted ski resorts calls for alternative approaches, with degrowth emerging as a potential pathway. This research attempts to investigate how and if degrowth is a desirable solution to address ski resorts struggling with severe climate change impacts, using the Swiss municipality of Lungern as a case study. Semi-structured interviews with key municipal stakeholders were conducted to explore the destination’s transformation. Following the bankruptcy of its ski resort, Lungern transitioned toward a downsized, more sustainable, and niche tourism offering, which has prompted a redistribution of ecological, social, and economic value, predominantly positive for the population. The municipality has demonstrated its ability to mitigate climate-related impacts and has strengthened its resilience in the face of broader crises, such as the COVID-19 pandemic. Although Lungern may be classified as a typical “loser” in the context of climate impacted ski tourism, it is perceived both by local stakeholders and through this analysis as a “winner” in achieving a sustainable transformation. This study further provides a practical example of a grassroots movement, contributing to the predominantly theoretical discussions in degrowth literature and offering an alternative narrative to what is often framed as a hopeless situation.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Orientarsi nella decrescita attraverso gli immaginari spaziali degli Appennini: il caso della stazione invernale della Doganaccia
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Questo contributo esamina declinazioni e negoziazioni della decrescita in specifici contesti territoriali. Concentrandosi sulla Doganaccia, una stazione invernale dell’Appennino tosco-emiliano, l’articolo esplora le narrazioni in contrasto tra loro emerse attorno al progetto di una funivia. Basandoci sulla tipologia degli immaginari spaziali di Watkins, analizziamo come i diversi attori invochino la decrescita sia per sostenere interventi infrastrutturali, sia per promuovere una rottura con un modello di crescita trainato dal turismo. Basato su una ricerca empirica qualitativa, lo studio evidenzia gli usi situati, contestualizzati e negoziati della decrescita nelle aree montane periferiche. Sosteniamo, infine, che la decrescita possa essere compresa non come un programma fisso, ma come una costellazione di immaginari spaziali, rivelando come i territori si orientino in contesti di incertezza ambientale ed economica.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Lehren aus der Vergangenheit: Eine Schweizer Fallstudie über Skigebiete und Degrowth im Angesicht des Klimawandels
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Der Skitourismus ist durch den Klimawandel stark bedroht, vor allem aufgrund geringerer Schneefälle, kürzerer Skisaisonen und einer zu erwartenden Marktschrumpfung. Diese Veränderungen führen zunehmend zu einer Spaltung des Skimarktes in sogenannte „Gewinner” und „Verlierer”. Künstliche Beschneiung, die nach wie vor als wichtigste Anpassungsstrategie an die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels weit verbreitet ist, steht aufgrund begrenzter Ressourcen und steigender Kosten vor wachsenden Herausforderungen. Darüber hinaus scheint Diversifizierung, die oft als nachhaltigste Lösung befürwortet wird, nicht auszureichen, um die erheblichen Verluste der verkürzten Skisaisons auszugleichen. Vor diesem Hintergrund sind alternative Ansätze erforderlich, um eine resiliente und nachhaltige Entwicklung in vulnerablen Skigebieten zu fördern, wobei hier Degrowth als möglicher Weg untersucht wird. Diese Studie erforscht anhand der Fallstudie der Schweizer Gemeinde Lungern, ob und wie Degrowth eine geeignete Lösung für Skigebiete sein kann, die mit Auswirkungen des Klimawandels zu kämpfen haben. Es wurden halbstrukturierte Interviews mit wichtigen kommunalen Akteuren geführt, um die Transformation der Destination zu analysieren. Nach der Insolvenz des Skigebiets orientierte sich Lungern neu und entwickelte ein kleineres, nachhaltigeres und auf Nischen ausgerichtetes Tourismusangebot, was zu einer Umverteilung ökologischer, sozialer und wirtschaftlicher Werte führte, die für die Bevölkerung überwiegend positiv war. Die Gemeinschaft hat ihre Fähigkeit unter Beweis gestellt, klimabedingte Auswirkungen zu mildern, und ihre Resilienz gegenüber Krisen wie der COVID-19-Pandemie gestärkt. Obwohl Lungern als typischer „Verlierer” eingestuft werden kann, wird es sowohl von lokalen Akteuren als auch in dieser Analyse als „Gewinner” bei der Umsetzung einer nachhaltigen Transformation wahrgenommen. Diese Studie liefert darüber hinaus ein praktisches Beispiel für eine „Grassroot”-Bewegung, die zu den überwiegend theoretischen Diskussionen in der Degrowth-Literatur beiträgt und ein alternatives Narrativ zu einer oft als hoffnungslos dargestellten Situation bietet.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Affouage as an Element of Intangible Cultural Heritage: Recognition of the Value of Mountain Knowledge and Practices to the Green Transition
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Affouage is a French ancestral practice of felling wood for domestic use that is primarily found in mountain areas thanks to the survival of collective use rights associated with land commons. In 2025 it was added to the French National Inventory of Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) as defined by UNESCO. The supporting submission highlighted the benefits of affouage for local communities, their living territory and the environment. Much more than just a simple logging operation, affouage is a vector of social cohesion. Its inclusion in the ICH inventory provides an opportunity to highlight not only the little known heritage and local knowledge of mountain areas, but also the system of collective land ownership that generates and perpetuates their cultural specificities, and which local communities are fighting to protect.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Se reconvertir pour fuir le management ? Recompositions de l’ethos managérial et circulations dispositionnelles
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Challenging media narratives about a supposed “disaffection” of executives for managerial roles, this article examines the career shifts of elite school graduates to explore how managerial ethos and dispositions are carried into new professional settings. Drawing on thirty biographical interviews, it shows that shifting career does not necessarily mean leaving management. The career changers express varying degrees of distancing from a managerial ethos, which may be confirmed, reformulated, reconfigured or rejected, alongside differentiated patterns of persistence of incorporated dispositions. Depending on the new professional contexts and on a relationship to managerial ethos shaped through successive socialisations, these dispositions circulate, are transformed or become inhibited. Career changes thus appear as a privileged observatory of dispositional circulations across professional worlds.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: La régulation des tensions productives du capitalisme : manager dans l’industrie aéronautique
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: In contemporary capitalism, managers have constantly occupied a position that is at once pivotal, ambivalent and exposed. Agents of regulation of the contradictions of industrial production, their functions and activities are characterized by uncertainties that constantly weaken their position in the organization of work. With the support of managerial practice and management systems, managers, despite often unstable social and productive situations, seem to see their missions and context of action become clearer: it is less about leading teams or organizing a productive activity than managing, piloting, managing resources, indicators and strategic objectives over which they have no control. Rationalizing work to contain social tensions seems to be the central activity of managers.

oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Through raw notes and commentary, the article recounts an unexpected observational situation that challenges certain preconceptions held by the authors. Interviews scheduled at a French nursing health care center gave way to the observation of a training session where salaried nurses were introduced to a management tool. Given how receptive nurses were to managerial logic, our observation raises questions about the ability of health care centers to implement a “social health” model. The managerial approach, introduced by a trainer who is also a self-employed nurse, is embraced by nurses as a mean to highlight their work and classify patients—not according to their social or moral value, but by financial worth.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: « Je sonne » : les livreurs Deliveroo sous l’emprise du management algorithmique
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: A decade after the advent of platform capitalism heralded the decline of traditional management in favour of self-employment, the managerial role remains intact. On the contrary, task assignment algorithms have transformed managerial duties, distributing them more widely and standardising practices. This evolution has also redefined the purpose of management, shifting focus from task evaluation to monitoring worker loyalty. This article examines management practices within a meal delivery company, highlighting the algorithm’s impact on the essence of management. Through the narrative of Shorif, a Bangladeshi Deliveroo rider, it delves into the mechanisms of control and the strategies couriers employ to counter the algorithm.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Trouble dans la supervision : les effets du télétravail sur les activités d’encadrement
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: By challenging the unity of space, time, and action in the workplace, teleworking affects management activities within organizations, especially since the health crisis led to its widespread adoption beyond trusted employees for whom it was traditionally reserved. Teleworking is causing confusion in supervision: it is changing the conditions under which it is carried out and encouraging a shift in focus from the activity being performed to the results of the activity, requiring the implementation of management by objectives and the extension of trust to categories of employees other than managers. However, these changes are neither obvious nor systematic: they do not unfold uniformly depending on the people being supervised and their presumed autonomy, and require managers to do three times as much additional organizational work, which is likely to increase their workload and discourage them from using the system.

oai_dc:dc.dc:description: By examining “what management means” in this corpus, the Nouvelle Revue du Travail aims to explore a subject that has only recently been developed in the sociology of work, having long banned the term “management” from its vocabulary, as it was considered too closely linked to a normative theory designed primarily for use by managers. oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Risco urbano e urbanização periférica: o papel do Estado na promoção da habitação digna em Petrópolis, Rio de Janeiro
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: This article discusses the housing issue in Petrópolis, considering its geomorphological, environmental characteristics and urban evolution associated with the history of climate impacts in the territory. Public housing promotion policies are analyzed as an attempt to address the deficit of decent housing for the needy population, through a review of urban legislation, analysis of housing projects carried out by the State, survey of socioeconomic and demographic data and interviews with public agents and residents of local communities. Faced with the tragedy of the rains in the summer of 2022, the last action of municipal management was the approval of the Municipal Law on Technical Assistance for Housing of Social Interest, ATHIS Law, which analyzes the implementation, the main difficulties and potential of its application in an empirical study in the 24 de Maio Community, one of the most affected in 2022 and the first to receive technical assistance interventions. The results show that the construction of housing complexes alone does not constitute a sufficient response to reduce the deficit and that the implementation of ATHIS by the public authorities is a viable alternative to the complex housing issue on slopes, risk situations or consolidated areas without infrastructure, guaranteeing the permanence of residents and access to decent housing.
